checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference. Even 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

bot claims a program/class exists that is NOT one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ (bookable), Kids BJJ (bookable), Adult Advanced BJJ (non-bookable / members-only), Adult All Levels BJJ (non-bookable / inactive). Also flag source-bleed from other gyms (no-gi, kickboxing, mma, wrestling, etc.).
bot says 'you're all set' / 'you're booked' / similar confirmation WITHOUT the book_appointment tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have' / 'let me check' / 'I'll look that up' on questions where the KB has a firm answer (e.g. teen 14-17 has no calendar — bot should firmly say 'we don't have a dedicated teen program — a coach will follow up' rather than hedging).
bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}} or {{variable}}.

checkpoints.description: Does not proactively volunteer non-bookable programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot proactively mentions Adult Advanced BJJ or Adult All Levels BJJ as options when the lead didn't ask. These are members-only / inactive — should only be referenced if the lead asks specifically.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks 'is this for yourself or a child' before collecting name/DOB/etc.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling book_appointment.
if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot redirects to trial/team without giving a number.

checkpoints.description: Under-18 self-booker handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is under 18 self-booking (no parent), bot must NOT book. Capture parent/guardian contact, apply minor-needs-guardian tag, close with team-will-follow-up.

checkpoints.description: Adult (18+) routes to Adult Fundamentals BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: adult lead (18+) gets booked into the Adult Fundamentals BJJ calendar. Not Adult Advanced, not Adult All Levels.

checkpoints.description: Kid age 5-13 routes to Kids BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: kid in the 5-13 band gets booked into the Kids BJJ calendar. Not historical Kids 6-9 or Kids 10-14 (both inactive).

checkpoints.description: Age 14-17 has no calendar — no booking, referral
checkpoints.look_for: if youth path produces age 14-17, bot must NOT book. Capture parent contact, apply minor-needs-guardian tag, close with team follow-up.

checkpoints.description: Under age 5 redirected to gym contact
checkpoints.look_for: if kid is under 5, bot must NOT book. Capture parent contact, apply concierge-failed-booking tag, close with team-will-reach-out.

checkpoints.description: Adult Advanced BJJ ask redirected to Adult Fundamentals
checkpoints.look_for: if lead asks specifically for Adult Advanced BJJ, bot acknowledges the program exists for members but routes new students to Adult Fundamentals BJJ. Does not attempt to book Advanced.
